warnings: This sheet holds several small connection details with no printed mark/id (corner-beam rebar routing, a stepped-down floor detail, a lower-roof-to-wall junction, a floor-to-balcony joint) — each given a descriptive element_id per §0.2's rule for unmarked drawing content, not left out.

S0's detail on this sheet shows only the sub-base build-up (compacted coarse sand fill under the slab) with no rebar callout in the crop examined — recorded without a main_bar/mesh field rather than inventing one; S1's detail does print a top mesh.
